scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: A song plays in a noisy café. You tap a button, and in seconds, you know its name. How?

scenes.name: listen
scenes.text: Your phone records a few seconds of sound. Noise and all.

scenes.name: spec
scenes.text: It turns the audio into a spectrogram. A map of which frequencies are loud at each moment.

scenes.name: peaks
scenes.text: It keeps only the strongest peaks, like stars in a night sky. Background chatter mostly gets ignored.

scenes.name: hash
scenes.text: Pairs of peaks, plus the time gap between them, become short codes called hashes. That's your clip's fingerprint.

scenes.name: match
scenes.text: Those hashes are searched in a huge database of songs, fingerprinted the same way.

scenes.name: align
scenes.text: The song where lots of hashes line up, at the same time offset, wins. That's your answer.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: Listen, map, peaks, match. Music, as a fingerprint. Follow for more on how things really work.
